Mark the provided projects as paused.

Sets spec.paused in the manifest of each named project. Paused projects are left alone by slipway
fetch and slipway sync, which run no git command in them; slipway rollout undo still acts on them.
Use slipway rollout resume to resume a paused project.

Usage: slipway rollout pause [OPTIONS] (<NAME>... | project/<NAME>...)

Arguments:
  <NAME>...
          The name of a project.

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h').

Examples:
  # Keep fetch and sync away from project dots
  slipway rollout pause dots

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
